excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content:
we pretty much ignore what the client passes as `committee_index` post-electra, see https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/blob/unstable/packages/beacon-node/src/api/impl/validator/index.ts#L956
```ts
index: isForkPostElectra(fork) ? 0 : committeeIndex,
```
this has worked so far... still need to do more mixed client testing before mainnet goes live

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content:
That seems reasonable, maybe worth switching Nimbus to that, so it never at least returns obvious garbage from the REST API endpoint, no matter what the client does.

But more broadly, it would be good for this to be specified explicitly
